title: FuzzInsight: Navigating the Efficiency-Effectiveness Trade-off in Coverage-Guided DNN Fuzzing
abstract: arXiv:2610.23195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Collecting and labeling diverse test datasets for evaluating Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) is costly and time-consuming. This has motivated coverage-guided fuzzing techniques that generate defect-revealing corner cases from limited test data. However, their effectiveness depends heavily on configuration choices, particularly coverage criteria and seed-selection strategies. We present a configuration-oriented analysis and decision guidelines for scalable DNN fuzzing targeting two bottlenecks: inefficient seed utilization and the cost of coverage guidance. Our analysis shows that existing seed-selection strategies repeatedly prioritize a small subset of inputs, leaving many collected seeds unexplored. To address this issue, we propose Equalized Sampling, a constraint-based strategy that increases mean seed queue utilization to 77%, improving on prior approaches by 13 percentage points. translated_title: FuzzInsight：在覆盖引导的DNN模糊测试中权衡效率与有效性
translated_abstract: 为评估深度神经网络（DNN）而收集和标注多样化的测试数据集既昂贵又耗时。这促使了覆盖引导模糊测试技术的发展，该技术能够从有限的测试数据中生成可揭示缺陷的极端用例。然而，其有效性在很大程度上取决于配置选择，特别是覆盖标准和种子选择策略。我们针对两个瓶颈——种子利用效率低下和覆盖引导的开销——提出了一种面向配置的分析方法以及可扩展DNN模糊测试的决策指南。我们的分析表明，现有的种子选择策略会反复优先选取一小部分输入，导致许多已收集的种子从未被探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出了均衡采样，这是一种基于约束的策略，可将平均种子队列利用率提升至77%，比先前方法提高了13个百分点。我们进一步在四个……上评估了84种模糊测试配置（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文针对覆盖引导DNN模糊测试中种子利用低效和覆盖引导开销两大瓶颈，提出均衡采样策略将平均种子队列利用率提升至77%（较先前方法提高13个百分点），并为可扩展的DNN模糊测试提供面向配置的分析与决策指南。
en_tdlr: FuzzInsight provides a configuration-oriented analysis and decision guidelines for scalable coverage-guided DNN fuzzing, and proposes an Equalized Sampling strategy that raises mean seed queue utilization to 77%—a 13 percentage-point improvement over prior approaches—to tackle inefficient seed utilization and the cost of coverage guidance.
